description: We are a team of young, innovative students searching to complete this challenge in order to grow as a group, bring our ideas together, and pave a path towards a more sustainable future.
summary: During space missions, astronauts are exposed to many hazards that threaten their health. Our challenge was to build health-monitoring software that gathers vital indicators and enables astronauts to evaluate and act on their health status. With certain parameters integrated, the program acts as a warning system to prevent overexertion and detect possible complications in advance.
details: Our health-monitoring software acts as an autonomous early-warning system for astronauts during long-duration space missions. It continuously collects vital health indicators, such as heart rate, cardiovascular strain, bone density trends, and radiation exposure, and compares them against each astronaut's personal baseline and historical mission data from NASA.
